$comment: Machine requirements for devwork-mcp. Single owner of this table: src/doctor.ts renders it for devwork_status and --doctor, and ../install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything. `required: false` everywhere is deliberate: an installation that carries its own credentials needs neither `gh` nor `az`, and only ambient auth does.

binaries.what: repository boundary detection for the optional .devwork-mcp.json layer
binaries.install: install git with your package manager

binaries.what: ambient GitHub login, used only when github.auth is "ambient"
binaries.install: brew install gh && gh auth login

binaries.what: ambient Azure DevOps login, used only when ado.auth is "ambient"
binaries.install: brew install azure-cli && az extension add --name azure-devops && az login --allow-no-subscriptions
